_about: The 2.433 operator's 09:42 UTC test pool on Base (launch block L, research/session_oct14/base2433 b02/b08), read from https://base.gateway.tenderly.co on 2026-10-14 11:24 UTC by research/session_oct14/base2433/b13_fixture.py. Keys: launch_block (L), pool (the v4 pool id), key (currency0, currency1, fee, tickSpacing, hooks), init_log (the PoolManager's Initialize, as eth_getLogs returns it), pool_logs (every ModifyLiquidity and Swap of the pool in L..L+31, in block/logIndex order: the add at +3 is two ModifyLiquidity events, the bot's buys from +8, the pull at +30), headers (L-1..L+32: number, hash, parentHash, timestamp, baseFeePerGas, hex as the node gives them), txs (hash -> eth_getTransactionByHash: the launch, the add, the bot's first three buys, the pull), receipts (hash -> eth_getTransactionReceipt, l1Fee included), roles (launch, add, bot_buys, pull -> their hashes), token_code (the token's runtime code at L+3), code_hashes (keccak of the runtime code of the token, the launcher and the hook; the launcher's and the hook's code are left out for size)
